table.retrieve:
SELECT
	SaleInvGroupDetail.SaleInvGroupCode,
	SaleInvGroupDetail.SaleInvCode,
	SaleLedger.Date,
	SaleInvGroupDetail.RowId,
	SaleLedger.CustCode,
	AliasName= Accounts.AliasName,
	CustomerName= Accounts.Name,
	posted=SaleLedger.posted,
	accountfor=SaleLedger.accountfor,
	impactinventory=SaleLedger.impactinventory,
	SaleLedger.InvTotal,
	SaleLedger.CustRefNo,
	SaleLedger.CustRefNo2,
	SaleLedger.CustRefNo3,
	SaleLedger.CustRefNo4,
	SaleLedger.CustRefNo5,
	SaleLedger.Remarks
FROM
	SaleInvGroupDetail, SaleLedger, Accounts
WHERE
	SaleInvGroupDetail.SaleInvGroupCode = :ai_code AND
	SaleInvGroupDetail.SaleInvCode = SaleLedger.SaleInvCode AND
	SaleLedger.CustCode = Accounts.AccCode
ORDER BY
	SaleInvGroupDetail.RowID
